title: stage-parallel-prefill-scheduler-with-speculative-chunking
author: Aisha Kumar
commits: a1e6f0f: introduce stage_parallel scheduler and token allocator
b2d7c9a: add partial_prefill CUDA kernel and Rust bindings
c3f8d44: streaming KV append fast-path and unit tests
d4a9b55: allow chunk coalescing in continuous batcher
e5b0e2f: add observability metrics and docs for prefill tuning
f6c1e77: add feature flag and canary rollout config
review_comments: Marco Lee: Nice end-to-end numbers. Two asks: (1) ensure we have a hard upper-bound on speculative memory to avoid OOMs under high fanout, (2) add an integration test that exercises misprediction discard path.
Aisha Kumar (author): Added memory_budget check and new test misprediction_discard in tests/integration/prefill_speculation_replay.rs. See commit c3f8d44.
Evelyn Park: kernel looks good but add a WARN-level trace when overlap_utilization > 90% to help on-call debugging.
Aisha Kumar: Added warn log and metric stage_overlap_utilization. CI includes a perf-run showing no regressions.
Jorge Santos: Approving on condition we land the canary runbook in infra; created infra ticket ENG-1172 to track rollout automation.
Marco Lee: Approved after canary config updated to include abort-on-error=true in canary group settings.
release_notes: Reduce tail latency for mixed prefill+decode workloads by overlapping prefill chunks with decode and introducing speculative prefill. Opt-in via feature flag and request header. Adds new runtime metrics for prefill behavior.
